title: FX rate
description: One record: one published exchange rate between two currencies on one date. Voyager use: forex.exchange_rates (from_currency, to_currency, rate).

base_currency.description: Currency being priced (1 unit of it).

quote_currency.description: Currency the rate is expressed in.

rate.description: Units of `quote_currency` per 1 `base_currency`, exactly as published.

rate_date.description: The date the rate applies to (YYYY-MM-DD).

local_currency_name.description: English name of `quote_currency`, if the page gives it.

source_url.description: The page's own link for this item (official site, booking or detail page), copied verbatim from the page.

as_of.description: The "last updated", "valid from" or publication date the page itself states for this information (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.description: A verbatim quote from the page.

evidence.description: Up to 3 short verbatim quotes from the page that support the most important facts.
